title: Feet That Find the Ground: Reaching Down Until Contact, a Ground Height Learned From Each Landing, and a Hole Told From a Step

artifact.note: feet that adapt to ground they have not seen: after the swing the foot goes on reaching down at a bounded rate until the contact sense of 34-07 says it is down (or until it has reached as far as the leg may, which is a hole and not a step), the height at which it touched is the ground there, an estimate of the ground's height under each foot is moved toward it by a gain (so that one bump does not move the body), and the body's height follows the mean of the estimates; tested over level ground, a bump, a step down and a hole, with the time the search added and what each foot ended with
